= component_demo: the fixture of a world
:toc: left
:toclevels: 2
:idprefix:
:sectanchors:

component_demo is a library with a world of its own, whose C bindings
wit-bindgen generates for wasip2 and wasip3, which the tests of the build place
in `libs/component_demo` of a scratch superproject.

[#holds]
== What it holds

component_demo has {n-tests} tests: {n-tests-native} run natively,
{n-tests-wasip2} on wasip2 and {n-tests-wasip3} on wasip3; wasmtime serves
{n-served} of them. Each of its {n-headers} headers compiles alone, the header
of the world's bindings on wasip2 and wasip3 only.
